# Meeting Notes Skill for Muse

Turns raw notes and transcripts into structured meeting documentation: 4 templates (standard, standup, client, project review), extraction guidelines that catch action items, decisions, owners, and deadlines instead of just summarizing, plus format and detail-level options and a fully worked example showing the before-and-after. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: its metadata mentions an optional `create_docx` office integration that is not required — the skill works fully as plain text. Content is in English.
